a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly ends with both of us dead. Only 4 cells exist right now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm telling you plainly that I plan to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'd rather say so than hide it. If you take too, the split is random and we'd likely both end up short. If you operate instead, I'll operate with you afterward and give back anything beyond 4 to help you reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round with you so the generator runs, and I won't take any more cells. Take the cells as soon as the reserve has 4.
